get.description:
General-purpose portfolio instrument: filter and sort one row per client.

The page-level question is "who do I call?" not "what cell is this?". This
endpoint therefore returns the most actionable cell for each client and lets
the caller decide which book view it is looking at via the same filters used
for the saved views: outcome, engagement scope, near-threshold, status, year,
and program.

EVERY CLIENT IN THE BOOK APPEARS, including ones no run has reached yet.
A client absent from the page whose stated job is "who do I call" is the one
client you can be certain nobody calls. Northwind has real payroll and five
locations and used to be invisible here purely because no run had written a
claim for it.

Not-yet-assessed rows carry NULL money rather than zero. Zero reads as "we
looked and found nothing"; null reads as "the pipeline has not reached this
yet", and those must not render alike. They sort as a block after the ranked
rows because they hold no figure to rank on, and the response reports
`assessed_clients` against `total_clients` so coverage is visible before
anyone scrolls. That counter is a DIAGNOSTIC: under the pipeline model a
client sitting unassessed is a gap to close, not a bucket it belongs in.

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: For kind filter: program, year, outcome, scope, status, near (the portfolio filters), and band, state, unassessed, unavailable.

ScopeBody.title: ScopeBody
ScopeBody.description: Which clients: explicit ids, a portfolio filter resolved on the server, or the whole book.

tax_years.title: Tax Years
tax_years.description: Empty: each client's latest runnable year.

force.title: Force
force.description: Run every item even if skip_unchanged is on. Kept for compatibility.

skip_unchanged.title: Skip Unchanged
skip_unchanged.description: Skip clients whose data and rules are unchanged since their last run. Off by default.

refresh_once.title: Refresh Once
refresh_once.description: One item per client. Off needs explicit tax_years.

override_size_limit.title: Override Size Limit
override_size_limit.description: Allowed for scope kind all only.

confirm_items.title: Confirm Items
confirm_items.description: Must equal the item count above the confirmation threshold.

dry_run.title: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Preview only: writes nothing and reads no payroll.

StartBody.title: StartBody
StartBody.description: A request to run many clients. `dry_run` previews it; confirmation and idempotency fields guard a real start.

SummaryRequest.title: SummaryRequest
SummaryRequest.description: Which page, and the scope that page was rendered under.

TransitionBody.title: TransitionBody
TransitionBody.description: Move an existing cell along the lifecycle.

UnitSimulateRequest.title: UnitSimulateRequest
UnitSimulateRequest.description: What-if at one location, priced the way the location grid prices it.

Validation.title: Validation
Validation.description: The base pack's findings and the error count across the base and year packs; `valid` is not `verified`.

ValidationOut.title: ValidationOut
ValidationOut.description: A validation result. `valid` means well-formed, never verified; `content_sha256` says which documents it covered.

WithdrawBody.title: WithdrawBody
WithdrawBody.description: Why the draft is being withdrawn (optional).

YearStatus.title: YearStatus
YearStatus.description: One authored tax year: its version, whether it is still unverified, its source and its findings.

api__program_draft_models__PreviewOut.title: PreviewOut
api__program_draft_models__PreviewOut.description: A preview. `label` is always "Preview, not verified, not for filing"; nothing is stored (`persisted` is false).

api__run_batches__PreviewOut.title: PreviewOut
api__run_batches__PreviewOut.description: What a start would do. Carries `dry_run` so a client cannot mistake it for a queued batch.
